text:
maya (PM): Quick async OKR milestone wrap — TL;DR: runtime-v3 shipped to canary, auth-v2 slipped (SSO flaky), infra canary tonight. Drop blockers / CR pings here. Short summary + links: https://go/reports/qtr-okr-wrap

rajesh (Eng Lead): Ship notes: rolled feature-flag for runtime-v3 to 50% yesterday; perf looks good (p95 down ~12%). Remaining tasks: docs, CRs, and canary dashboards. Assigning @sam for CR follow-ups.

sam (Eng): On it — I have 3 CRs for runtime-v3: `serve/handler` change, `kv-cache` tweak, and `api-compat` tests. Will post review links in ~1h.

jon (Infra): Infra note: Canary window starts 22:00 PT. Reserved capacity in us-west-2 and set autoscale policy `canary-small`. If deploy needs rollback, ping me and I can drain nodes quickly.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z — runtime-v3/canary -> 12 instances (us-west-2).

kelly (QA): QA update: auth-v2 slipped due to flaky e2e on the SSO path — root cause looks like a timing race in the oauth handshake. Recommend reverting the SSO-specific changes from auth-v2 and re-landing once we have stable harness results.

maya (PM): Decision: revert SSO portion in auth-v2 for now, keep non-SSO fixes. Product will prep a customer note for Friday. @rajesh can you confirm revert ETA?

rajesh (Eng Lead): Can revert by EOD tomorrow; opening a revert PR now. We'll also add an e2e harness test to catch this timing regression before next landing.

sam (Eng): Posted CRs: https://go/reviews/123 , https://go/reviews/124 , https://go/reviews/125 — tagging @kelly for the test matrix and smoke runs.

kelly (QA): Thanks — starting smoke + regression runs after CR merge. I'll flag any blocking failures on the test board and put short repro steps in the ticket.

maya (PM): Ownership recap (quick): runtime-v3 -> rajesh / sam; auth-v2 (revert + followup) -> rajesh / kelly; infra canary -> jon; comms -> maya (I'll loop in growth for the customer note). Next steps: if no blockers by EOD tomorrow we close this item. :white_check_mark:

jon (Infra): FYI: automatic rollback policy is on — if canary shows >3% error increase we'll roll back. I'll post a manual override if we want a staged backout instead.

sam (Eng): Noted. I'll watch `errors` and `latency` dashboards. If we see `kv-cache` OOM patterns, revert the change in CR 124 first.

maya (PM): Thanks team. I'll draft the external note and share with @growth. Closing this thread unless someone posts a blocker.
